tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: las byang chung ba tshor ba rang grol snying po bzhugs so:

zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: skal ldan blo dman don du ni: zhi khro 'dus pa'i las byang bstan: 'di la le'u gsum yin te: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo: dang po sngon 'gro la yang gsum: bka' bsgo mtshams gcod byin brlab bo: t+ya/ta/ya/: dang po bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: phyogs bcu kun kyang zhi khro'i lha: rab tu gang nas 'od 'phros pas: lus ngag sems la gnod byed cing : mchod pa'i mdangs 'phrog ma rig bgegs: nyon mongs ma rig rgyu las byung : 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: gnyis pa mtshams gcod 'di skad do: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : rgya gram 'khor lo me ri'i gur: rim pa drug gi tshul du bskor: khro tshogs sprul pa dpag med kyis: rab tu gtams shing mtshams bcad do: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma tsakra dz+wa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ gsum pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang nyid las: thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid: sman raka gtor mchod dngos po rnams: stong nyid bdag 'dzin bral ba las: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum me rlung chus: bdag gzhan rtog pa'i dri ma sbyangs: me rlung chu yang 'od du zhu: sman raka gtor mchod dngos por gyur: rtog gnyis dag nas snod bcud rnams: 'dod pa'i yon tan du mar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā bha ling+ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai wid+ya shap+ta āḥhūm̐: sngon du 'gro ba'i le'u'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:thrat+ya/tha: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i le'u bstan: lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol zhing : phyag mchod bstod bshags bdun gyis bstan:

dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa ni: hūm̐: rtog bral bsgom med de bzhin nyid: kun khyab rang gsal kun tu snang : 'gag med rgyu yi āḥmathing gsal: stong gsal rang babs gdos bcas bral: aḥlas e yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ 'phros: nam mkha' rlung chu sa gzhi brdal: aḥlas bh+rum̐ 'phros gzhal yas khang : zur bzhi logs bzhi sgo bzhir ldan: stong pa'i dbyings su 'ja' ltar shar: phyi dang nang med zang thal gsal: yid 'ong mdzes ldan gzhal yas khang : rgyal ba zhi khro'i bzhugs gnas so: bh+rum̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dz+nya na tsakra maṇ+ḍal bh+rum̐: hūm̐: bdag nyid tha mal rang sems 'di: rtog med skad cig dran rdzogs su: kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing : chos nyid bzang mo sku mdog dkar: mnyam bzhag skyil krung gnyis med 'khril: dal dbus pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar: seng ge glang chen rta mchog dang : rma bya shang shang khri steng du: longs sku rigs lnga yab yum gsal: hūm̐: rnam snang dbyings phyug sku mdog dkar: 'khor lo dril 'dzin gnyis med 'khril: rang snang dkyil 'khor dbus phyogs su: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: hūm̐: rdor sems spyan ma sku mdog mthing : rdo rje dril 'dzin gnyis med 'khril: g.yas su sa snying myu gu dkar: g.yon du byams pa klu shing dkar: mdun du lā se me long dkar: rgyab tu puṣ+pe me tog dkar: rdo rje rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: rin 'byung mā ki sku mdog ser: rin chen dril 'dzin gnyis med 'khril: g.yas su kun bzang snye ma ser: g.yon du nam snying ral gri ser: mdun du mā le phreng 'dzin ser: rgyab tu dhu pe spos phor ser: rin chen rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: snang mtha' gos dkar sku mdog dmar: pad+ma dril 'dzin gnyis med 'khril: g.yas su spyan gzigs pad 'dzin dmar:

g.yon du 'jam dpal ral gri dmar: mdun du gīrti pi waṃ dmar: rgyab tu ā lo mar me dmar: pad+ma rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: don grub sgrol ma sku mdog ljang : rgya gram dril 'dzin gnyis med 'khril: g.yas su sgrib sel po ti ljang : g.yon du phyag rdor rdor 'dzin ljang : mdun du ghan+dhe dung phor ljang : rgyab tu nirti zhal zas ljang : las kyi rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: zhi ba'i lha tshogs de rnams kyang : longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chas rnams rdzogs: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: 'dzin med ma bcos rang gsal bsgom: hūm̐: steng du brgya byin pi waṃ dkar: 'og tu chos rgyal me chu nag: shar lhor thags bzang go mtshon ljang : lho nub shāka thub gseg shang ser: nub byang seṅge po ti mthing : byang shar kha 'bar sgrom bu dmar: 'gro don mdzad pa'i thub pa drug: pad rkyang steng na bzhengs stabs gsal: hūm̐: shar sgor rnam rgyal lcags kyu dkar: lho sgor gshin rje zhags pa ser: nub sgor rta mgrin lcags sgrog dmar: byang sgor bdud rtsi dril bu ljang : tshad med bzhi ldan yab yum brgyad: khro bo'i tshul rdzogs 'dor stabs bzhugs: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus smug nag: rdo rje kha ṭāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon: kro ti shwa ri gnyis med 'khril: hūm̐: dbus su bud+dha he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus smug nag: 'khor lo dgra s+t+wa ral gri g.yas: dril bu thong gshol bhan+dha g.yon: bud+dha kro ti gnyis med 'khril: hūm̐: shar du badz+ra he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag:

rdo rje bhan+dha dgra s+t+wa g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol g.yon: badz+ra kro ti gnyis med 'khril: hūm̐: lho ru rat+na he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ser nag: rin chen kha ṭ+wāṃ be con g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rtse gsum g.yon: rat+na kro ti gnyis med 'khril: hūm̐: nub tu pad+ma he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar nag: pad+ma kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rnge'u chung g.yon: pad+ma kro ti gnyis med 'khril: hūm̐: byang du karma he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang nag: ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol g.yon: karma kro ti gnyis med 'khril: khrag 'thung gtso bo yab yum bcu: khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs par ldan: byol song gtso bo rin chen brag: pad+ma nyi steng gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: shar phyogs kau'u rī zhing dbyug dkar: lho phyogs tsau'u rī mda' 'geng ser: nub phyogs pra mo chu srin dmar: byang phyogs be ta bhan dmar ljang : shar lho puska rgyu 'dren ser: lho nub ghasma bhan dmar ljang : nub byang tsan+dha rgyu za ser: byang shar sme sha ro za mthing : zhing chen gdan la gar stabs 'gying : ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: de yi phyi rim phyogs mtshams brgyad: sengha seng gdong ro za smug: bya kri stag gdong lag bsnol dmar: sri la wa gdong spu gri nag: shwa na spyang gdong ro thogs mthing : kri ta bya rgod rgyu 'dren ser: kaṅka dur bya zhing phrag dmar: kha khwa bya rog bhan gri nag: hu lu 'ug gdong lcags kyu mthing : zhing chen gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: shar du rta gdong lcags kyu dkar: lho ru phag gdong zhags pa ser: nub tu seng gdong lcags sgrog dmar: byang du sbrul gdong dril bu ljang :

tshad med bzhi ldan sgo ma bzhi: zhing chen gdan la gsal bar bskyed: hūm̐: shar du zhi ba'i las mdzad bdun: srin mo g.yag gdong rdo rje smug: tshangs pa sbrul gdong pad+ma ser: lha chen gzig gdong tri shul ljang : gtog 'dod pre gdong 'khor lo sngo: gzhon nu dred gdong mdung thung dmar: brgya byin dom mgo rgyu zhags dkar: zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: hūm̐: lho ru rgyas pa'i las mdzad bdun: rdo rje pha waṃ spu gri ser: zhi ba chu srin bum pa dmar: bdud rtsi sdig gdong pad+ma dmar: zla ba khra mgo rdo rje dkar: be con wa gdong dbyug to ljang : srin mo stag gdong thod khrag nag: zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: hūm̐: nub tu dbang gi las mdzad bdun: za ba bya rgod be con ljang : dga' ba rta gdong khog chen dmar: stobs chen khyung gdong dbyug to dkar: srin mo khyi gdong rdo rje dmar: 'dod pa pu shud mda' 'geng dmar: nor srung shwa mgo bum pa ljang : zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: hūm̐: byang du drag po'i las mdzad bdun: rlung lha spyang gdong ba dan ljang : mi mo skyin gdong gsal shing dmar: phag mo phag gdong mche zhags nag: rdo rje khwa gdong zhing chung dmar: sna chen glang chen bam chen ljang : chu lha sbrul gdong sbrul zhags ljang : zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor phyi rim sgo bzhi ru: shar du khu byug lcags kyu dkar: lho ru ra gdong zhags pa ser: nub tu seng gdong lcags sgrog dmar: byang du sbrul gdong dril bu ljang : zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang : ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya yi: bsgom khog 'dus pa'i sgron me'o: sa ma ya: t+ya/t+ya/t+ya/: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa lha tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: dpe med bsam brjod bral ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir:

bla ma rin chen kun bzang chos kyi sku: longs spyod rdzogs sku bcom ldan rigs lnga yab: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum mchog lnga dang sbyor: sku gsung thugs yon gsal la 'gag pa med: 'gro don yid snang dag pa'i gnas mchog tu: kun bzang rigs lnga yab yum gtso 'khor rnams: rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: tshogs brgyad gnas dag byang chub sems dpa' brgyad: yul brgyad gnas dag sems ma chen mo brgyad: 'gro don rdzogs mdzad sprul sku thub pa drug: phrin las 'gro don sgo ba yab yum brgyad: zhi ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal: bcom ldan dpal chen rigs lnga he ru ka: gnyis med yum chen kro ti lnga dang 'khril: dug lnga 'joms phyir khrag 'thung sprul 'khor bcas: 'gro don yid snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir byon: hūm̐: kau'u rī la sogs gnas bdag ma mo brgyad: sengha la sogs yul bdag phra men brgyad: rta gdong la sogs ye shes sgo ma bzhi: dkyil 'khor mu ran dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: bka' srung gter bdag dam can chos skyong tshogs: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs rnams: 'gro don yid snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir byon: rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gsum pa lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: sgyu ma gzugs brnyan chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : stobs ldan rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: chos sku kun bzang sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las lnga yi rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: bcom ldan dpal chen rigs lnga yab yum bcu: sems dpa' sems ma yab yum bcu drug bcas: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: rnam thar brgyad ldan sgo ba yab yum brgyad:

rigs drug dong sprugs bcom ldan thub pa drug: zhi ba'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas bzhi bcu gnyis: rang snang gnas yul dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du: phyogs mtshams rang rang bzhugs pa'i gdan khri la: gnyis med rang bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: zhi ba longs sku'i rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: dug lnga 'joms pa'i lha tshogs dpag med 'phros: bcom ldan khrag 'thung rigs lnga he ru ka: shes rab dbyings phyug kro ti lnga dang sbyor: yab yum sras dang bka' sdod sprul 'khor bcas: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: kau'u rī la sogs gnas bdag ma mo brgyad: sengha la sogs yul bdag phra men brgyad: tshad med bzhi ldan ye shes sgo ma bzhi: sprul pa'i las mdzad dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad: du ma ro gcig brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bzhi pa gus pas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: yid chos gnas dag kun bzang yab yum la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: phung lnga gnas dag ye shes lnga dang ldan: longs sku rigs lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: 'byung lnga gnas dag bde chen ye shes ngang : dbyings kyi yum chen lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: tshogs brgyad gnas dag sems dpa' chen po brgyad: yul brgyad gnas dag sems ma chen mo brgyad: nye ba'i sras mchog byang sems bcu drug la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rigs drug dong sprugs sprul sku thub pa drug: tshad med bzhi ldan sgo ba yab yum brgyad: zhi ba'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: dug lnga 'joms mdzad khrag 'thung khro bo lnga : dbyings kyi yum chen kro ti lnga dang sbyor: khrag 'thung khro bo yab yum bcu rnams la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: kau'u rī la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad:

sengha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad: rta gdong la sogs ye shes sgo ma bzhi: bka' yi las byed dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: khrag 'thung lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: lnga pa phyi nang gsang mchod ni: dang po phyi'i mchod pa 'di skad do: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: dpag med nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs la: dag pa rnam gsum yid kyi mchod pa'i sprin: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: snang stong rig stong gsal stong bde stong dang : dran stong grags stong tshor stong mchod pa'i tshogs: me tog bdug spos dri zhal rol mor bcas: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: gnyis pa nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: lha rdzas nang mchod 'bul ba ni: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje gzugs sgra dri ro dang : rdo rje chos ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: gus pa'i sems kyis 'bul lags na: 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: gsum pa gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: snang ba yab la stong pa yum: gsal ba yab la 'od zer yum: bde ba yab la stong pa yum: sgra grags yab la grags stong yum: dran pa yab la rig stong yum: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bde: rig ma dkar ser dmar ljang mthing : bde ba ye shes kun ldan du: bde ba'i ro snyoms mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon dgyes phyir bzhes: sman raka gtor gsum 'bul ba la: dang po sman mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rigs lnga yab yum gnyis kyis rgyu byas te: sku lnga ye shes lnga yi rkyen byas te: thabs shes rgyu la ma 'gags rkyen sbyar ba'i: dam pa rigs brgya'i 'bru bcud bdud rtsi 'di:

bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: thugs rje brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha ram̐ khā hiḥ gnyis pa rak+ta 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru bsgral ba'i khrag: ma chags chags bral chags pa chen po'i khrag: gnyis med 'dzin bral gsang ba'i khrag chen 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: ma hā rak+ta la kha ram̐ khā hiḥ gsum pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi snod 'jig rten gtong gzhong du: nang bcud sems can gtor mar bshams: rtsi bcud 'bras bu sman gyis brgyan: zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: ma hā ba ling+ta la kha ram̐ khā hiḥ sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: sku ni mi 'gyur ka dag zang thal sku: gsung ni mi 'gags rang byung ye shes gsung : thugs ni mi g.yo bsam brjod bral ba'i thugs: kun bzang skye 'gag med la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: chos sku nam mkha' lta bur kun la khyab: longs sku nyi 'od lta bur so sor 'phro: sprul sku 'ja' tshon lta bur 'gro don mdzad: rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjod 'od zer 'phro: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul zhi ba'i tshogs: mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan rnams mdzes tshul ldan: zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang : rgod dang gshe dang rngam par ston pa dang : snying rje ngo mtshar che tshul gar dgur ldan: khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thal chen rak+ta zhag gi zo ris dang : ko rlon g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thabs dang : thod phreng sbrul chun me dpung chas dgus brgyan: dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung ba'i las la brtson: rnal 'byor kun gyi dam tshig rjes gcod cing : bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzad pa'i: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdun pa bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang mtha' bral chos kyi sku: nyag gcig zang thal skye med longs spyod rdzogs: shar grol 'gag med sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku: rgyal ba zhi khro sprul 'khor dgongs su gsol: bdag dang 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyis: gti mug 'khrul sems dpag med blangs pa nas: da lta tshe 'di'i lus blangs yan chad du: rig dang ma rig 'khrul pa'i las dbang gis: sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig chag nyams nor 'khrul gyur pa kun: mi gsang mi sbed gnong 'gyod mthol lo bshags: klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par gsol: oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ phrin las dngos gzhi'i le'u gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa rjes kyi le'u bdun gyis bstan: tshogs las bskul dang chad mdo gtor skyong dang : gtor bro bkra shis smon lam bdun yin no: dang po tshogs 'khor bshams la 'di skad do: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: tshogs la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: lan chags gnas 'dir ma 'dug par: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ gnyis pa bsang sbyangs byin brlab ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid rdor sems thugs ka nas: oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing 'phros: zhal zas dngos po thams cad kun: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum ngo bor gyur: 'bru gsum me chu rlung gsum 'phros: tshogs kyi rnam rtog bsregs gtor bkrus: me chu rlung gsum 'od du zhu: sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsir gyur: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams: dgyes mchod bdud rtsi chen por gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥha hoḥ gsum pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: ma bcos chos dbyings zhing khams nas: bla ma kun bzang yab yum dang : rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs dang bcas: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: de nas tshogs phud gsum bcad la: dang po mchod pa 'di skad do: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang thig le'i sku:

nyag gcig zang thal longs spyod rdzogs: cir mi dgongs pa sprul pa'i sku: rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhi khro'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprul 'khor bcas: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bar pa bshags shing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bdag cag 'khor ba'i sems gzhi blangs pa nas: da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa yan chad du: rig dang ma rig bag chags dbang gyur pas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnams: zhal zas tshogs 'bul bskang zhing bshags par bgyi: bzod par bzhes la tshangs par stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ skabs 'dir zhi khro'i mdangs bskang la sogs dang : lta ba'i klong bshags la sogs ci rigs bya: tha ma tshogs phud bsgral zhing bstab pa ni: hūm̐: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : thabs kyi cho 'phrul rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: khrag 'thung rngam brjid 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs la: nyon mongs ma rig dug lnga phung po lnga : bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus pa: myur du khug la bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: gnyis pa phung po zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro sprul 'khor bcas: mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma zhal phyes shig: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: ye shes lnga ldan mi 'gyur zhal du bstab: rnam rtog bag chags chos nyid klong du rol: bstab bo bzhes shig rol cig kha ram̐ khā hiḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ gnyis pa srung ma las la bskul ba ni: hūm̐: bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas su: mkha' 'gro chos skyong bka' srung rnams: la las bstan pa'i gzhi 'dzin mdzad: la las bka' yi bya ra mdzad: la las chos mdzad srung ma mdzad: la las gtsug lag dkor khang bsrung : la las yul dgon dben gnas bsrung : la las dam tshig las rjes gcod: la las sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad: la la stong gsum khyab par nyul: la la bsam gtan ngang la gnas: la la skye 'gro'i bla tshe brku: la la srog gcod srin po'i rigs:

la la gtsang sbra bram ze'i rigs: la la rims dang nad kyi bdag: la la ltas ngan cho 'phrul bdag: sprul pa yang sprul bsam mi khyab: 'khor dang las byed bye ba 'bum: kun kyang zhi khro'i cho 'phrul te: rig rtsal rol pa thogs med 'phro: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces pas bskul zhing phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa bka' yi chad mdo ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: bcom ldan khrag 'thung che mchog he ru kas: dregs pa rū tra'i sde dpung btul ba'i tshe: kau'u rī phra men dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang : srung ma dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyis: ci ltar khas blangs dam bcas de bzhin du: gtor ma 'di bzhes bdag gi sdong grogs mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar: chad tho'i dam can srung ma thams cad kun: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: da lta rnal 'byor bdag gi sdong grogs mdzod: bzhi pa gtor skyong bya ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ shar gyi dbang phyug ma bdun gtor ma longs: nyon mongs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ lho yi dbang phyug ma bdun gtor ma longs: bsod nams ye shes rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ nub kyi dbang phyug ma bdun gtor ma longs: 'khor 'das dbang du sdud pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ byang gi dbang phyug ma bdun gtor ma longs: ma rig sdig sgrib tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i: bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis dang : bran g.yog 'khor bcas bka' yi gtor ma longs: mi mthun bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol: nyams rtogs bsod nams 'phel ba'i sdong grogs mdzod: bcol ba'i phrin las khyod kyis 'grub par mdzod: lnga pa gtor bro brdung ba 'di skad do: hūm̐: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i phyogs bcu nas: dug lnga 'joms pa'i ye shes lnga ldan gsal:

gsal 'tsher sgyu ma'i lha dang lha mos bskor: phyogs bcu bde gshegs rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: dug lnga'i mgo la ye shes chems se chem: bro yang ye shes lnga yi snang stong bro: glu yang ye shes lnga yi snang stong glu: ye shes lnga yi glu blangs bro brdungs pas: rnam rtog mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: ma rig nyon mongs ka dag dbyings su non: oṃ āḥhūm̐ staṃ bha ya nan: drug pa bkra shis brjod pa ni: oṃ: chos sku'i bkra shis stong zhing bdag med shog: āḥ longs sku'i bkra shis gsal la 'dzin med shog: hūm̐: sprul sku'i bkra shis thugs rje'i rgyun 'byung shog: gzhi yi bkra shis rang rgyud 'dul bar shog: lam gyi bkra shis gzhan rgyud sbyong bar shog: 'bras bu'i bkra shis gzhi thog smin par shog: ces brjod dbyangs bcas me tog 'thor: bdun pa bsngo ba smon lam ni: na mo: 'khor gsum yongs dag rab dkar dge ba 'disaḥ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa: sku gsum 'bras bu myur du smin par shog: 'gro ba sems can yongs kyi dpal du shog: lha tshogs gshegs su gsol ba ni: oṃ: khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod: rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol: sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang : slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: badz+ra muḥ rjes su rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni: gzugs snang thams cad zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: lha tshogs nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar: snang stong gnyis med mtha' bral ngang la bzhag: sgra grags thams cad zhi khro'i lha tshogs gsung : grags stong nam mkha'i 'brug sgra yal ba ltar: grags stong brjod med ngang la mnyam par bzhag: dran bsam thams cad zhi khro'i thugs su shar: shar grol klong thim mkha' la sprin dengs ltar: thugs dgongs ma bcos skye med ngang la bzhag: a a āḥ de nas spyod lam rnam bzhi rjes thob dus: skad cig stong gsal chen po'i ngang nyid las:

rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal ma bral bar: snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas spyod: zhi khro rigs brgya 'dus pa'i las byang chung ba tshor ba rang grol snying po zhes bya ba rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: grub thob karma gling pa'i gter ma'o:
